Package aor.proj3t.resource

Class TrainingResource

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.resource.TrainingResource
@Path("/trainings") @RequestScoped @Produces("application/json") @Consumes("application/json") public class TrainingResource extends Object
REST endpoint for training-related operations.

This class handles RESTful operations related to training sessions, including creation, updates, area management, user participation, and filtered queries for training data. Access controls are enforced based on user roles.
